title: Project configuration — living-docs capability
description: Formal shape of the project's `.pkit/capabilities/living-docs/project/config.yaml`: what the capability needs that the backbone does not (living-docs DEC-001 point 1) — each documentation space's entry point, and the space each place outside every documentation root belongs to. The places themselves are declared in the backbone configuration's `friction.places` (COR-050), which a capability may not extend (COR-048); this file assigns them, joined by path. A place inside a documentation root belongs to that root's space unless assigned here; a place outside every root must be assigned here. `places` is a mapping so that each place names exactly one space. Whether an assignment names a declared place, and whether every out-of-root place has one, is the capability's validation, not this schema's. Document-shaped schema: the file IS the resource (no top-level id collection). Companion per COR-018.

binds_to.description: Repo-relative globs matching the adopter-data files this schema validates (COR-023 fallback binding). Present on the capability-side carrier; absent from a project's file.

spaces.description: The project's documentation spaces, keyed by id. `user` and `technical` are the two every project has (DEC-001 point 1); a project may add others.

places.description: Place → space: the space each project place belongs to, keyed by the place exactly as `friction.places` writes it. Required for a place outside every documentation root; for a place inside one, an entry assigns it away from that root's space.

entry-point.description: The page a reader of this space starts from: a path relative to the repository root.

repo-relative-path.description: A path relative to the repository root. Not absolute.
